fresh_policy: OS entropy in a separate process after candidate freeze; no retries or candidate changes after evaluation

gates.requirement: New deficit discovered from errors, memory and external data; no operator-queued next task.
Native concrete goal: inputs, output property, success criterion and downstream utility.
Goal, parent genome, runtime, source documents and PASS rules frozen before solution generation.
Native selection of program, engine policy, grammar or algorithm mechanism, with evidence.
Native knowledge query/source selection; provenance and hashes; evaluation separated.
Kernel-generated executable mechanism, isolated compilation; no ready library implementation.
Fresh blind external evaluation after freeze, 100 percent, no adjustment.
All inherited G0 through G20 skills retained at 100 percent.
Removing precisely the new capability reduces new-task performance.
Atomic admission, separate-process cold replay, exact previous-genome rollback.
After restart, native discovery and execution of another task using the admitted mechanism.
Three consecutive generations, each causally uses its predecessor; all preceding gates met.

goal_origin_policy: no new tasks may be registered by this runner; old failures may supply observations, never fresh blind labels
knowledge_sources: native request and native ranking; external search/HTTPS transport
known_architectural_limits: The new problem constructor is maintainer-written and limited to relation subgoals of failed permutations.
The property ontology covers only numeric and dotted-integer comparison; this is not unrestricted problem invention.
The inherited failed task originated with the operator; a derived subgoal does not erase that provenance.
The existing specification compiler handles bounded word equations and block recurrences, not arbitrary natural-language algorithms.
This broker stops after an admission until an explicit process restart; it does not supply a transfer task.
on_failure: stop and preserve WITHHOLD; no prearranged fallback task
